title: A FAIR Comic about Research Data Infrastructure — LaTeX sources

creators.name: Hamann, Tobias
creators.affiliation: Chair for Intelligence in Quality Sensing (IQS), WZL, RWTH Aachen University, Aachen, Germany

description:
LaTeX source code for the multilingual research comic "A FAIR Comic about Research Data Infrastructure, Part 1: From Charlemagne to ing.grid". The repository provides the ing.grid document class setup, the comic page and text-placement macros, the language files (English, German, Latin, Elvish) and the SciKGTeX annotations used to embed machine-readable research contributions into the PDF.
